#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:** Know
 this, my beloved:
 when the Divine
 Proceeding descended
 into
 created
 minds
, it
 bore
 with
 it three
 degrees
 of accommod
ated truth — truth
 as
 understanding
, truth as love, and
 truth as knowledge
 in
 the natural degree. The
 Divine cloth
ed itself in these three forms
 of truth
, taking
 them upon
 itself so
 as
 to be received.
 Through
 these three accommod
ated forms
, it
 established all
 order
 in the
 whole
 of the
 human
 mind, both in
 its
 interior fac
ulties and in its exterior fac
ulties. It arranged all
 things according
 to these degrees
 so
 that
 the Divine could
 be made
 manifest.
 Afterward
, when
 its
 works of
 ordering
 were accomplished
, it laid
 open
 these accommod
ated forms
 before
 those
 who are
 in states of good — revealing
 what
 lay
 within
 and
 beneath
 the
 cov
erings.


**¶2:** Now,
 when the Divine was about to release these
 accommod
ated tru
ths from
 their fixed
 arrangement
, it unf
astened them from their ou
termost contain
ment,
 and thus these three degrees
 of truth are disposed
 from
 the
 lowest
 boundary
 of the natural
 mind
 up
ward,
 encomp
assing all states
 within
.
 The ou
termost contain
ment —
 the natural degree that
 bounded
 all
 things from
 without
 — is loos
ened at
 its highest
 point of
 attachment
 to
 the interior
;
 and that
 natural
 boundary
 is set
 below
 the
 interior
 degrees
 and
 elevated
 back
 toward
 the in
most origin
 from
 which,
 in
 the
 beginning, the
 Divine
 Proceeding had first
 sent
 it forth
.

---

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know this, my beloved ones, that when the Living Spirit came he brought the three garments; that of wind, that of fire, and that of water. He assumed them from [the Mother of Life, and] he has [clothed himself] in them in those three garments [, and through them] he established [them] for all the things of [this univers]e, both above and below. He arranged them in the [order of all things, and through them] he was displayed. Afterwards [, when] his works [were accomplished throughout] the [whole of the creation, h]e stripped them off before [the ri]ghteous ones.

Now, when he was about to loose[n them from their established ordering, he] divested himself of them from their (clasp) and he [revealed what is withi]n them, and thus these three g[arme]nts are arranged [in their order] from below the edges of the zone as they clothe i[t al]l [, from below] up [to] above [. And that which is] up [from] above them strips them of the zone from that place at its topmost point; and it is placed below them and ra[ised u]p to the heights above, from which it had been sent o[u]t at their beginning.
